res=[83,88,222,254,444,495,506,601]
nonres=np.array([i for i in range(768) if i not in res])
for l in range(12):
    p=f'bert.encoder.layer.{l}.'
    info=[]
    for ln in ['attention.output.LayerNorm','output.LayerNorm']:
        w=base(p+ln+'.weight'); b=base(p+ln+'.bias')
        info.append((np.round(w[res],2).tolist()==[1.0]*8, np.abs(b[res]).max(), round(float(w[nonres].mean()),3), round(float(w.min()),2),round(float(w.max()),2)))
    q=base(p+'attention.self.query.weight'); k=base(p+'attention.self.key.weight'); v=base(p+'attention.self.value.weight'); o=base(p+'attention.output.dense.weight')
    ob=base(p+'attention.output.dense.bias'); fo=base(p+'output.dense.weight'); fi=base(p+'intermediate.dense.weight'); fob=base(p+'output.dense.bias')
    cuts=(np.abs(q[:,res]).max(),np.abs(k[:,res]).max(),np.abs(v[:,res]).max(),np.abs(o[res]).max(),np.abs(ob[res]).max(),np.abs(fi[:,res]).max(),np.abs(fo[res]).max(),np.abs(fob[res]).max())
    print(l, info, [round(float(c),3) for c in cuts])
